summary: Frontend-only regression for the two Sales-Orders UX changes. PASS on all 6 review items. Mobile viewport 390x844, warehouse@test.com/test123. (1) Orders -> Sales Orders segment renders inline: so-create-btn, 'Orders by status' line chart with Saved/Picked/Shipped/Returned legend, status tabs so-tab-saved/picked/shipped/returned, so-search, sort chips so-sort-date/order_number/field1/field2, and the orders list - NO so-orders-btn in DOM (count=0). (2) Pagination: Saved tab initially shows 10 rows with so-show-more visible; tapping so-show-more increased rows from 10 -> 12 and the button disappeared (12 saved orders total <= 10+25). (3) State reset: typing 'ZZNOMATCH' in so-search filtered list to 0; tapping so-sort-order_number reorders; switching to so-tab-shipped (0 rows) then back to so-tab-saved shows rows=10 with so-show-more reappearing (pagination reset to 10). (4) Purchase tab unaffected: tab-purchase renders 'PURCHASE ORDERS' header, AI Insight card, Suggested Reorders, auto-po-btn, Order History with DRAFT/SENT statuses; so-create-btn does NOT leak (count=0). (5) Scan bar placement on Saved order 2606A000032: absolute Y positions captured via DOM = so-pdf-pick: 401 (in top actions card near header), so-wh (Ship-from chip 'Main Warehouse'): 991, so-scan-pick: 1058, so-add-product (Order items header): 1122. So so-scan-pick is BELOW the ship-from selector and ABOVE the Order items list, AND no longer in the top actions card (which still contains only so-pdf-pick). (6) Create flow: so-create-btn navigates to /sales-order/new; tapping so-save returns to /orders with the Sales segment active and so-create-btn re-rendered, list reloads via useFocusEffect.
critical_code_review_comments: SalesOrdersPanel.tsx pagination uses both useFocusEffect AND useEffect on loadList - on focus, two loads fire back-to-back. Harmless but redundant; useEffect alone (with loadList in deps) plus a single useFocusEffect for chart would suffice.

SalesOrdersPanel useEffect resets visible to INITIAL on status/q/sort change (good), but does NOT reset when the orders array shrinks below current visible after a refresh - minor: if total drops to e.g. 5, visible stays at e.g. 35 which still works because slice clamps, but show-more correctly hides. Acceptable.
sales-order/new.tsx: save() does not validate non-empty items - an empty order can be created. Probably intended to allow drafts; flag if business rule requires >=1 item.
seed_data_creation: Used existing seed: 12 Saved sales orders. One new empty Saved order was created via the create flow test (no items); no other data created.
